title: ChemArgus: Automated Scientific Diagnostics for Lab-Grade Multimodal Chemistry Reasoning: A Frontier Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.20012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chemistry evaluation has moved past multiple-choice probes toward open-ended expert problems, yet the benchmarks that define the current frontier still score answer endpoints alone. Such scoring conflates memorized facts with stepwise derivation, treats visual and textual inputs as interchangeable, and confounds long-horizon planning with stepwise execution. These blind spots prevent any diagnosis of where the reasoning chain breaks in a model. We present ChemArgus, a competition-level chemistry benchmark drawn from chemistry competition material, textbooks, and research papers, whose scoring replaces the answer endpoint with three measurement properties. Fine-grained scoring grades every subquestion point by point with partial credit, so a score lands at the level of the step rather than the outcome. translated_title: ChemArgus：面向实验室级多模态化学推理的自动化科学诊断：一个前沿基准
translated_abstract: 化学评估已经从选择题探测转向开放式专家问题，然而定义当前前沿的基准仍然只对答案终点进行评分。这种评分方式将记忆的事实与逐步推导混为一谈，将视觉和文本输入视为可互换的，并将长程规划与逐步执行混淆。这些盲点使得无法诊断模型的推理链在何处断裂。我们提出了ChemArgus，这是一个竞赛级化学基准，取材于化学竞赛材料、教科书和研究论文，其评分体系用三个测量属性取代了单纯的答案终点评分。细粒度评分对每个子问题逐点评分并给予部分得分，因此分数落在步骤层面而非结果层面。多模态能力在每道包含真实图像的题目上进行考核，并配有受控的文本描述进行对照，因此视觉理解……
tldr: ChemArgus是一个竞赛级多模态化学推理前沿基准，通过细粒度分步评分（含部分得分）和真实图像配受控文本描述的题目设计，能够诊断模型推理链在何处断裂，而不仅评估最终答案。
en_tdlr: ChemArgus is a frontier competition-level multimodal chemistry reasoning benchmark that employs fine-grained step-wise scoring with partial credit and real-image problems paired with controlled text descriptions to diagnose where a model's reasoning chain breaks, rather than merely evaluating answer endpoints.
